title: 三星折叠屏新机发布，苹果秋季跟进
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Samsung has its big hardware event. Let's start on the smartphone side of what Samsung's announcing. Where is their focus?
segments.zh: 三星召开了大型硬件发布会。我们先从智能手机方面看三星的发布重点。他们的焦点在哪里？

segments.en: So, three new phones. There's the new Flip Phone. There's the new Ultra Phone, the Z Fold 8 Ultra. That's their high-end foldable phone.
segments.zh: 这次有三款新手机：新款翻盖手机、新款高端折叠屏手机Z Fold 8 Ultra，以及中端折叠屏手机Z Fold 8。

segments.en: But I want to talk to you about the Z Fold 8, which is their new mid-tier foldable. Replaces the larger size they've had for a few years now.
segments.zh: 我想重点说说Z Fold 8，这是他们的新款中端折叠屏手机，取代了之前几年的大尺寸机型。

segments.en: It's the one you're showing on screen right now. It's incredible. It's amazing. It's going to sell super well.
segments.zh: 就是屏幕上展示的这款。它非常出色，令人惊叹，销量一定会很好。

segments.en: It's the same exact form factor that Apple is going to be releasing this fall. The wide format is awesome for gaming.
segments.zh: 它的外形与苹果今年秋季即将发布的机型完全相同。宽屏格式非常适合游戏。

segments.en: It's pretty good for multitasking. Where it really shines is e-book reading and watching video on YouTube and what have you.
segments.zh: 多任务处理表现不错，但真正的亮点是电子书阅读和观看YouTube视频等。

segments.en: It's a little shorter than your typical phone, but wider. It's a really cool form factor. You have to get your hands on it to really understand it.
segments.zh: 它比普通手机略短，但更宽，外形非常酷。你得亲手体验才能真正理解。

segments.en: I'm pretty pumped for the Apple version, but the Samsung one's going to do great too.
segments.zh: 我很期待苹果的版本，但三星这款也会大获成功。

segments.en: Okay, smart glasses. Samsung has actually had quite a lot to say about smart glasses. Where are they on the product side? And why are they worried about privacy when it comes to smart glasses?
segments.zh: 好的，智能眼镜方面。三星其实已经透露了不少信息。产品进展如何？他们为什么担心隐私问题？

segments.en: Yes, so they're launching their glasses in concert with Google and Warby Parker and Gentle Monster later this year.
segments.zh: 是的，他们将于今年晚些时候与谷歌、Warby Parker和Gentle Monster合作推出智能眼镜。

segments.en: We're told these have about nine hours of battery life. These are standard fair. All the smart glasses without displays that you're seeing from Meta from Google.
segments.zh: 据说这些眼镜有大约九小时的电池续航。这是标准配置。所有来自Meta和Google的无显示屏智能眼镜都是如此。
